role: Simulation architecture
implementationNotes: Split demand generation, eligibility, signalling, media, workforce, messaging, information processing and economics. Retain aggregate operation with representative traces.

role: Simulation architecture
implementationNotes: Keep deterministic shortest paths for transport. Call control, queue routing and information policy require their own evaluators.

role: Simulation architecture
implementationNotes: Evaluate capability, customer policy and dependency health first, then preference, quality and cost. Do not assign universal cloud or vendor precedence.

role: Simulation architecture
implementationNotes: Retain transport ECMP. Use session affinity and supported application load distribution for calls, meetings and workflows.

role: Simulation architecture
implementationNotes: Reserve relevant transport, sessions, media and dedicated processing without conflating them with workforce availability.

role: Simulation architecture
implementationNotes: Track people, seats, active users, rooms and agent entitlements independently from usage and quality.

role: Simulation architecture
implementationNotes: Use separate latency, jitter, loss, codec, meeting and application-response assumptions; original thresholds are game balancing, not a UC quality standard.

role: Simulation architecture
